story-context.title: Simplified AI Output + Deterministic Layout Foundation
story-context.overview: Replace coordinate-heavy LLM output with a simplified semantic contract and deterministic grid compiler pipeline. Build DB-rooted prompt/capability/version governance, ensure per-component validation contracts are structured, and make width-class resolution canvas-responsive (compact/half/full). Preserve strict traceability from prompt versions to final DefinitionJSON.

critical-objectives.item: Step 1 owns intent; Step 2 owns deterministic grid resolution.
Capabilities and validation rules are auto-ingested from framework metadata snapshots.
Tuning uses one-variable-at-a-time changes with correlated logging evidence.

dependencies.story: Closed as learning; provides diagnostic and tuning foundations.

constraints.item: Grid-only layout model for AI compile path. No non-grid execution path.
Do NOT run Alembic commands from agent shell unless Anthony explicitly asks.
No hidden auto-repair without trace visibility (raw semantic plan vs final output).
Benchmark and CI flows must run without OpenAI secrets by default (mocked harness).

path.note: Entry point for generation, trace capture, correction loop behavior, and deterministic compile stages.
Request/response contracts and trace metadata structures.
Builder AI entrypoint, runtime context assembly, and apply-to-canvas flow.
Current sectioned prompt structure to align with DB-rooted prompt registry approach.
Framework source for component capabilities, surfaces, spacing, and validation expectations.
Correlation and extraction guide for inbound/outbound chain diagnostics.

file.purpose: Dev execution contract including one-change tuning discipline.
Human UAT with capability snapshot and correlated logging checks.
Gate evidence with AC mapping, RequestID chains, and benchmark outcomes.

acceptance-mapping.ac: Simplified semantic output contract; no explicit pixel geometry required from model.
Deterministic planner compiles semantic output into valid DefinitionJSON.
Trace includes raw semantic summary and final transformed summary.
Post-processing transforms are explicit and configurable.
Benchmark baseline records first-shot and final outcomes for all 10 prompts.
Builder apply path remains visible/selectable/editable on canvas.
Existing regression tests remain green or changes are documented.
Capabilities are versioned, machine-readable, framework-driven snapshots.
Validation normalization is contract-driven per component type.
Width classes resolve against current canvas width/grid with deterministic fallbacks.
Generation run captures prompt/capability/validation/width policy versions.
Framework source-of-truth validation confirms new components are auto-covered.
At least one controlled one-variable tuning sequence includes correlated logs.
SM story pack artifacts exist before Dev execution begins.
